Name: Get Started - Sprinklers in the mail
Author: proudunicorn
Description:
[size=4][size=5]About[/size]

[size=3]With this mod you will get some sprinklers and optionally a seedmaker in the mail from Spring 4 in year 1.

Useful if you want sprinklers early on, but don't want to feel like you are cheating by spawning them.

You must have 2 HEARTS with the 2 NPCs (characters) who will send you the items.﻿

I won't say who because SPOILERS. UPDATE: You can look in the Articles tab to find out who sends you the items (or just open up the mail.json).
[s][/s]
There are 3 options - all with / without a seedmaker:
(A) 6 quality sprinklers
(B) 12 quality sprinklers
(C) 24 quality sprinklers

If you would prefer a different number or type of sprinkler you can:
- edit the mail.json
or
- post a request in the comments and I will try to upload your config :)

[size=5]Installation[/size]

[/size][/size][list=1]
[*][size=4][size=3]Download the option you would like[/size][/size]
[*][size=4][size=3]Put "[b][MFM] Get Started[/b]" in your mods folder.[/size][/size]
[/list]

[size=5]Requirements
[/size][size=4][size=3]You need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1536]Mail Framework Mod[/url]

[size=5]Why[/size]?

I made this mod because I am using a large farm map and mods to make my game more difficult (Seeds are Rare, Minerva's Harder Community Centre bundles PPJA option) and I found that at the beginning of the game I spent most of my time watering and looking for wild seeds.

This mod gives you a bit more free time early on in the game, which is useful if you are playing with a lot of expansions.
[/size][/size]

Added update key.
